s04.client_chat.cc_001: I'm sorry to do this over a screen. I have not been able to say his name out loud since Friday.
s04.client_chat.cc_002: Rui Andrade. My partner. We started FAROL in a garage on Rua do Aleixo in 2014 and last Thursday I found him on his own kitchen floor.
s04.client_chat.cc_003: You will not have heard of us. We make a wristband. You press it, it calls whoever you told it to call. Forty thousand people wear one. Rui's mother wore one for two years before she died, that is the whole origin story, there isn't a cleverer one.
s04.client_chat.cc_004: His wife was there that night. Marta. They were signing the divorce on Thursday and she came round on Wednesday instead, and I do not know what happened in that house but I know she was in it.
s04.client_chat.cc_005: The police have been polite and slow. Nobody has opened his phone. I have the admin account for our whole fleet, so I can put you on his device — properly, live, as it sits.
s04.client_chat.cc_006: I am not asking you to agree with me. I am asking you to read it and tell me what is in there. If it says I am wrong about her I will take that too.
s04.client_chat.cc_008: Thank you. You're connected. He never secured anything properly — he was sentimental about stupid things.
s04.client_chat.cc_009: Start with the two of them. The messages. You'll see what I mean straight away.
s04.interstitial.is1_002: I know how the shares thing reads. I do. But money isn't the only reason people do things — twelve years of being the smaller person in the room is a reason too.
s04.interstitial.is1_003: Keep going. There's a recording somewhere on there, I'm almost sure of it. He had the phone set to catch things.
s04.interstitial.is2_002: That is her voice, that is her sentence, and that is the night he died. I have listened to it forty times and I still have to put the phone down halfway.
s04.interstitial.is2_003: Write it up. Put your licence number on it, send it to me, and I'll take it to Nogueira and to the police the same afternoon.
s04.interstitial.is2_004: You've done the job. Genuinely. Send me an invoice with the report.
s04.interstitial.is3_002: I'm not going to tell you how to do your work, but the police reached the same conclusion three days ago and they had a whole team. There is nothing under this.
s04.interstitial.is3_003: I'll be honest with you, because we're both adults: you are spending my money now, not looking for anything.
s04.interstitial.is3_004: Send me what you have and let's be finished.
s04.closing_chat.cl_002: You are going to want me to say something. I've been sitting here for an hour trying to work out what a person says here and there isn't a version that sounds like anything but what it is.
s04.closing_chat.cl_003: The numbers were mine. Beatriz gave me thirty-eight per cent failure indoors and I gave the board four. Not to get rich — to get to the next round, so we could fix it with money we did not have yet. That is what I told myself in March and it was even true in March.
s04.closing_chat.cl_004: Rui found it in October. He wasn't angry. That was the unbearable part. He sat in my kitchen and said we'd recall everything and stand in front of it together and I'd probably do eighteen months, and he said it kindly, like he was offering me something.
s04.closing_chat.cl_005: I let myself into his house to change his mind. That is the truth and it is also the excuse, and I know the difference.
s04.closing_chat.cl_006: He pressed it. Do you understand what I am telling you? He was on the floor and he pressed our button, the one we drew on a napkin, and my phone lit up in my hand while I was standing over him. It worked. The one time it mattered in my whole life, it worked, and I turned it off.
s04.closing_chat.cl_007: The recording was Marta at the theatre in March. He recorded all of them. I renamed a file. Two weeks of my life gone into a scheduled task, like a man doing his job.
s04.closing_chat.cl_008: Now listen to me, because this part is not about me.
s04.closing_chat.cl_009: Turn me in and FAROL dies inside a month. The recall takes a year, and for that year forty thousand people wear nothing at all, and the firmware never gets fixed because there is nobody left to fix it. Leave me where I am and I have it done in three months. Quietly. Properly.
s04.closing_chat.cl_010: That was Rui's plan too. He just didn't want it to be me who did it.
s04.closing_chat.cl_011: So. It's yours now. What do you do with it?
s04.closing_chat.cl_011.opt3: Fix the device. I never opened the phone.
s04.closing_chat.cl_013: Of course. I'd have thought less of you.
s04.closing_chat.cl_014: They'll have me by Sunday and the company by Christmas. Two hundred people who did nothing wrong will find that out from a news alert. I'm not arguing — I'm telling you what you bought, because you should know what it cost and not just what it was worth.
s04.closing_chat.cl_016: Marta walks, which she should. And I keep the company, and I fix the thing, and Rui's file sits open in a drawer in Matosinhos until everyone in it is dead. You've decided the living are worth more than him. I'd probably have decided the same. It still makes me sick that you did.
s04.closing_chat.cl_018: Then it gets fixed. February, maybe March. Nobody dies in a stairwell with a dead button on their wrist and nobody ever knows why not. And Marta spends the rest of her life being the woman they could not quite prove it against, in a city where everyone is quite sure. You have made that happen, not me. I want you to hold that, since I have to.
s04.closing_chat.cl_019: This account closes in a minute. You were better than I needed you to be — that was the whole risk and I took it anyway, because I thought a professional would stop where the evidence was tidy. Everyone does. You didn't.

s04.mail.gm_001.subject: Revised settlement — Andrade
s04.mail.gm_001.body:
Dear Mr Andrade,

Attached is the revised settlement reflecting your wife's instruction of 3 November.

I want to be clear on the record, for the third time, that Mrs Andrade has declined any interest in the shares of FAROL Lda, including the deferred class B allocation she is entitled to under the 2014 agreement. I have advised her twice in writing that this is materially against her interest. She has confirmed twice in writing that she understands.

Her words, which she asked me to include: "He built it before me and he'll be building it after me. I'm not taking a piece of it to punish him."

Signing is scheduled for Thursday 15 November, 11:00, at my offices.

Carla Nogueira
s04.mail.gm_002.subject: March field data — raw
s04.mail.gm_002.body:
Rui,

These are the unedited logs from the March programme. 412 activations across 60 devices, indoor and enclosed environments.

Successful transmission: 255.
Failed or delayed beyond 90 seconds: 157.

That is 38.1 per cent. The figure that went to the board in April was 4 per cent, and I do not know how to say the next part politely, so: the 4 per cent number is the subset of open-air tests only. Somebody chose that subset.

I am not sending this from my work account and I would ask you not to forward it from yours.

Beatriz
s04.mail.gm_003.subject: Re: March field data — raw
s04.mail.gm_003.body:
Beatriz,

I've read it four times. You're not wrong and I'm not going to pretend to look for a reading where you are.

I'm going to do this properly and slowly, which means I am going to say nothing for three weeks while I check every number myself, because if I'm going to end a man's career I'd like to be certain rather than furious.

You did the right thing. Don't carry it in the meantime.

Rui
s04.mail.gm_004.subject: Recall scenarios — DRAFT, do not circulate
s04.mail.gm_004.body:

If we recall: 40,200 units, ~€3.1m, insurance covers none of it. Company is finished inside a quarter. Two hundred and six people out of work, most of them junior.

There is no version of this where I get to be clever. Recall.

Tell V. on Thursday, face to face, alone. He'll take it better without the room.

V —

I've written this four times and deleted it four times, so this one is going in the drafts too and I'll say it out loud on Thursday like a grown man.

I know about April. I know it was you who cut the set. I am not going to ask you why because I already know why, and the why is not the problem.

We are recalling all of it. I'll stand next to you when we announce it and I will not say your name once. What happens after that is out of my hands and I won't pretend otherwise.

Twenty years. I'd rather do this badly with you than well without you.

R.

s04.notes.note_001.title: Thursday
s04.notes.note_001.block_001: Say it plainly. Don't soften it into nothing the way you do.
s04.notes.note_001.block_002: 1. The April number was cut from the March set. I know. Say I know.
s04.notes.note_001.block_003: 2. We recall. All of it. Not negotiable, don't pretend it is to make him feel consulted.
s04.notes.note_001.block_004: 3. I stand next to him for it. I don't say his name. He'll want to argue about that — let him win that one, it costs nothing.
s04.notes.note_001.block_005: 4. Ask him why. Actually ask. Twenty years and I've never once asked him a question he couldn't answer with a joke.
s04.notes.note_002.title: 3am recording?
s04.notes.note_002.block_001: Phone made a voice memo at 03:02 last night. Forty seconds. Nothing on it but the fridge.
s04.notes.note_002.block_002: I did not record anything at three in the morning. I was asleep. Marta has been gone since August so nobody else touched it.
s04.notes.note_002.block_003: Settings say it came from a scheduled automation. I have never made an automation on this phone in my life — I build hardware, I don't play with the phone.
s04.notes.note_002.block_004: Created 31 October. I was in Matosinhos on the 31st. Vasco had the flat keys that week for the boiler man.
s04.notes.note_002.block_005: Probably nothing. Ask him Thursday, after the other thing, when we're both still speaking.
s04.notes.note_003.title: For Marta, if I ever send it
s04.notes.note_003.block_001: You asked me once what I would do if the company went. I said I'd start another one and you said that wasn't an answer, it was a symptom.
s04.notes.note_003.block_002: It's going. I'm the one ending it. I wanted you to hear that from me and not from the news, and I've realised I don't have a way to tell you that isn't also asking you for something.
s04.notes.note_003.block_003: You didn't take the shares. Nogueira has told me twice like it's a symptom too. It isn't. I know exactly what it is.
s04.memos.vm_001.title: ARGUMENT_2340
s04.memos.vm_001.transcript:
(Room tone, hard and echoing — a large empty space, not a kitchen. A woman's voice, projecting, close to the mic.)

"You've had eleven years to say it and you've said it to everyone except me."

(A beat.)

"Then finish it. Finish it tonight — I don't care any more."

(A chair scrapes somewhere far off. A man's voice, distant, not in the scene: "Hold there — Marta, from 'eleven years' again, and take the pause." Two or three people laugh quietly. The recording continues for another nine seconds of shuffling and stops.)
s04.memos.vm_002.title: Untitled
s04.memos.vm_002.transcript: (Forty seconds. A fridge compressor cycling. A car passes outside. Nobody speaks. The recording ends on its own.)
s04.memos.vm_003.title: matosinhos indoor, run 3
s04.memos.vm_003.transcript:
(A man's voice, close, tired, in a concrete stairwell — his own echo two syllables behind him.)

"Run three, stairwell, minus two. Pressing now."

(Twelve seconds of nothing.)

"Nothing. Again — pressing."

(Nineteen seconds of nothing.)

"Right. So it isn't the enclosure, it's the whole indoor case. Beatriz was being kind."

s04.ending.expose: The full file goes to the Polícia Judiciária on the Sunday. Vasco Pinto is charged in the first week of December and the company is in administration before Christmas; the recall is announced by an insolvency administrator who has never seen the device, and it is still nineteen per cent complete a year later. Marta Andrade is cleared without ever having been charged, which she says is not the same as being cleared. Two hundred and six people find out from a news alert, exactly as he said they would. Beatriz Lima cannot get a job in the industry and does not understand why for a long time.
s04.ending.marta_only: You hand over the properties file, the rehearsal date and the automation, and nothing else. Marta is left alone inside a fortnight and moves to Lisbon in the spring. The firmware is rewritten quietly over the winter and pushed in February; forty thousand bands start working the way the box always said they did, and nobody is ever told they hadn't been. Rui Andrade's file stays open at Matosinhos with no suspect in it. Vasco sends money to Rui's mother every month for the rest of her life and she never learns why a man who is not her son does that.
s04.ending.deal: The band gets fixed. February, quietly, the way he said. Somewhere in the year that follows a woman in a stairwell presses hers and it transmits, and she never knows she is the reason any of this mattered. Marta Andrade is questioned twice more and released twice more, and stays in Porto, because leaving would look like something. Fifteen months later a journalist asks you why the case went cold and you find that you have an answer ready, and that you have had it ready for a long time.

s04.notes.f_note_104.title: The threshold argument
s04.notes.f_note_104.body:
Raise it and the thing is polite and useless. Lower it and it interrupts people who are fine.

Everybody in this market has chosen polite. They chose it because a device that speaks up when nothing is wrong looks bad in a room full of investors, and a device that stays quiet when something is wrong looks like nothing at all.

We are choosing the one that looks bad. Write that down somewhere it cannot be quietly reversed.

s04.chats.g_wa_504: Man in Braga has worn his in the sea. Twice. He is asking why it stopped.
s04.chats.g_wa_505: Tell him honestly and send him a new one.
s04.chats.g_wa_506: We do not have a policy for that.
s04.chats.g_wa_507: We do now. Write it down.
s04.chats.g_wa_508: A daughter wrote in. Her mother pressed it and she got there in eleven minutes. She wanted us to know.
s04.chats.g_wa_510: It is printed. It is on the wall by the bench, where the hardware side has to walk past it.
s04.mail.f_gm_201.subject: A pulseira soltou-se
s04.mail.f_gm_201.body: Good afternoon. The band came off twice this week, both times when I was putting on a cardigan. It has not broken. It simply opens. I am 74 and I do not want to be the person who complains, but I thought you would want to know.
s04.mail.f_gm_202.subject: Fecho — mesmo problema
s04.mail.f_gm_202.body: My mother has had the same thing with the clasp and a knitted sleeve. Photograph attached, which I hope is more use than a description.
s04.mail.f_gm_203.subject: Não carrega
s04.mail.f_gm_203.body: It has stopped charging. The little pins have gone a strange colour, greenish. It is two months old.
s04.mail.f_gm_204.subject: Water
s04.mail.f_gm_204.body: I have swum in the sea with it on two occasions. It worked after the first and not after the second. I accept this may be my fault but I would like to ask anyway.
s04.mail.f_gm_205.subject: A luz azul
s04.mail.f_gm_205.body: At night there is a small blue light and my husband says it keeps him awake. Is there a way to turn it off, or should we put a piece of tape on it? We have put a piece of tape on it.
s04.mail.f_gm_206.subject: Obrigada
s04.mail.f_gm_206.body:
I want you to know what happened. My mother fell in the hall on Tuesday and she pressed it and I was there in eleven minutes. She would not have rung me. She has never once rung me for anything.

I do not know how to thank a company. I hope this is the right way.
s04.mail.f_gm_207.subject: Pergunta antes de comprar
s04.mail.f_gm_207.body: Does it need a telephone? My father does not have one and will not have one and the other products all seem to require one.
s04.mail.f_gm_208.subject: Devolução
s04.mail.f_gm_208.body: I would like to return it. There is nothing wrong with it. My father will not wear it and I have decided not to make him.
s04.mail.f_gm_209.subject: Encomenda para lar — 30 unidades
s04.mail.f_gm_209.body: We run two homes in Braga and have heard about you from São Bento. Could you tell us what a thirty unit order would look like and whether you can support us from Porto.
s04.mail.f_gm_210.subject: Escola Básica — pedido
s04.mail.f_gm_210.body: A teacher here saw one on a pupil. Do you make a version for children? We understand if not.
s04.mail.f_gm_211.subject: Reclamação — prazo de entrega
s04.mail.f_gm_211.body: Ordered on the 2nd, promised five days, arrived on the 19th. The band is good. The waiting was not.
s04.mail.f_gm_212.subject: Bateria
s04.mail.f_gm_212.body: You say nine days. I get six. I am not angry, I would just like to know whether six is normal or whether mine is faulty.
s04.mail.f_gm_221.subject: Transporte — palete em falta
s04.mail.f_gm_221.body: We are unable to locate the pallet at this time. The consignment was scanned at Porto and again at a hub. We are treating it as lost and have opened a claim.
s04.mail.f_gm_222.subject: Transporte — palete localizada
s04.mail.f_gm_222.body: The consignment has been located at our Vigo facility and will be returned to Porto within two working days. We apologise for the inconvenience.
s04.mail.f_gm_223.subject: Revestimento dos contactos — proposta
s04.mail.f_gm_223.body: For the plating change you asked about: hard gold over nickel, minimum 0.8 microns. Tooling is unaffected. Lead time six weeks and the unit cost rises by about forty cents.
s04.mail.f_gm_224.subject: Retest — marcação confirmada
s04.mail.f_gm_224.body: Your retest is booked for 8 December. Please deliver three samples one week beforehand. This is the final slot of the year.
s04.mail.f_gm_225.subject: Concorrência — nota de mercado
s04.mail.f_gm_225.body: A competing device launched this week at four times your price point. Our read is that it is aimed at insurers rather than families, which may not be your fight.
s04.mail.f_gm_226.subject: Re: Curriculum — segunda tentativa
s04.mail.f_gm_226.body: I am writing again because I would rather be a nuisance than assume. My final year project is a low power wake-on-motion board and I have attached it whether or not you have a job.
s04.mail.f_gm_227.subject: Seguros — proposta revista
s04.mail.f_gm_227.body: Revised quotation attached, reflecting the change of use to a care setting. The premium is higher and the exclusions are narrower, which is the trade you want.
s04.mail.f_gm_228.subject: Fatura — envio de amostras
s04.mail.f_gm_228.body: Invoice for courier of three samples to the notified body. Signature required on delivery, as requested.
s04.mail.f_gm_229.subject: Newsletter — Hardware Weekly
s04.mail.f_gm_229.body: This week: the plating decision nobody talks about until it is too late, how one team survived a lost pallet, and a reader argument about whether battery figures should be measured worn or in a drawer.
s04.mail.f_gm_230.subject: Convite — mesa redonda, saúde e tecnologia
s04.mail.f_gm_230.body: We are assembling a panel on ageing at home and would like a founder who has actually shipped something. Forty minutes, no slides.
s04.mail.f_gm_231.subject: Lar de São Bento — obrigada
s04.mail.f_gm_231.body: The staff wanted to send something and could not agree on what, so it is chocolates. Please do not read anything into the quantity.
s04.mail.f_gm_232.subject: Recrutamento — perfil de firmware
s04.mail.f_gm_232.body: We have three candidates who match your brief. Our fee is fifteen per cent of first year salary, which we appreciate is a number you are not currently able to think about.
s04.mail.f_gm_250.subject: Re: A pulseira soltou-se
s04.mail.f_gm_250.body:
Thank you for writing, and please never worry about complaining — this is the most useful mail we have had this month.

The clasp opens against a knitted sleeve. It is our fault, not yours. We are changing it, and in the meantime a replacement is on its way to you with a different strap.
s04.mail.f_gm_251.subject: Re: Não carrega
s04.mail.f_gm_251.body: The green is oxidation on the contacts and it is a fault in the plating we chose. A replacement is on the way. You do not need to send the old one back, though we would like it if you can.
s04.mail.f_gm_252.subject: Re: Water
s04.mail.f_gm_252.body: It is not your fault, it is ours for not being clearer. It survives a shower and it does not survive the sea. A replacement is on the way, and I have added a line to the manual.
s04.mail.f_gm_253.subject: Re: A luz azul
s04.mail.f_gm_253.body: The tape is a completely reasonable solution and we are embarrassed you needed it. There will be a night mode in the next update, which installs itself.
s04.mail.f_gm_254.subject: Re: Obrigada
s04.mail.f_gm_254.body:
Thank you for telling us. Eleven minutes is the whole of what we are for, and most of the time nobody ever tells us.

I have printed your message and put it where the people who built it can see it.
s04.mail.f_gm_255.subject: Re: Pergunta antes de comprar
s04.mail.f_gm_255.body: It does not need a telephone. It needs a small base unit that plugs in at the wall, and that is all.
s04.mail.f_gm_256.subject: Re: Devolução
s04.mail.f_gm_256.body:
Of course. A refund is arranged and there is nothing to explain.

For what it is worth, deciding not to make him is the right call and it is a harder one than buying it was.
s04.mail.f_gm_257.subject: Re: Encomenda para lar — 30 unidades
s04.mail.f_gm_257.body: Thirty is more than we have shipped to one place, and I would rather say that than pretend otherwise. Can we come to Braga and see the building first.
s04.mail.f_gm_258.subject: Re: Escola Básica
s04.mail.f_gm_258.body: We do not make one for children and we are not going to. Thank you for asking, and please tell the pupil her band is being talked about in an office in Porto.
s04.mail.f_gm_259.subject: Re: Bateria
s04.mail.f_gm_259.body: Six is low and yours is not faulty. Nine is measured with the radio up and no triggers; a band that is used gets less. I would rather tell you that than argue.
s04.mail.f_gm_260.subject: Re: Revestimento dos contactos
s04.mail.f_gm_260.body: Go ahead with the hard gold. Six weeks is fine. Send the revised unit cost to Beatriz.
s04.mail.f_gm_270.subject: Re: Recrutamento — perfil de firmware
s04.mail.f_gm_270.body: Fifteen per cent of a salary I cannot pay is a number I would love to be able to be insulted by. Come back to me in the spring, when I will either have
s04.mail.f_gm_271.subject: Para o Vasco
s04.mail.f_gm_271.body: You have carried this longer than I have and I have never once said so in writing. If anything happens to the company I want it on record somewhere that the reason it existed at all was
s04.notes.f_note_201.title: The eleven minutes
s04.notes.f_note_201.body:
A daughter wrote in. Her mother fell in the hall, pressed it, and she was there in eleven minutes.

The line I keep going back to: "She would not have rung me. She has never once rung me for anything."

That is not a testimonial and I am not going to use it as one. It is the reason. Print it, put it on the wall, do not put it in the deck.
s04.notes.f_note_202.title: The clasp — what we knew
s04.notes.f_note_202.body:
We knew. In April Beatriz said a sleeve would open it and I said we would look at it after certification, and then certification took eleven months.

Nine people have now written in about it. Not one of them was angry. Every single one of them apologised for complaining.

That is worse than being shouted at and I would like to remember that it is worse.
s04.notes.f_note_203.title: Plating — the decision
s04.notes.f_note_203.body:
Thin plating, taken in June for a six week lead time. Three units back from São Bento at two months with green contacts.

Hard gold, 0.8 microns, six weeks, forty cents a unit, eight thousand to change.

We change it. And we tell them we are changing it, and why, before anybody finds out we took the cheap one knowingly. The second half is the part that will be tempting to skip.
s04.notes.f_note_204.title: What the competitor got right
s04.notes.f_note_204.body:
The box. The onboarding. The fact that a nurse can set one up without reading anything.

What they got wrong: the threshold. Two hundred drops on a rig, eleven triggers. It is a device that has been tuned to look good in a room rather than to work in a hallway, and it will sell four times as many as us.

Both of those sentences are true at once and I have to hold both.
s04.notes.f_note_205.title: Support — standard replies
s04.notes.f_note_205.block_001: Apologise once, then say what we are doing
s04.notes.f_note_205.block_004: If it is our fault, say the word fault
s04.notes.f_note_205.block_005: Sign it with a name, never with the team
s04.notes.f_note_206.title: Things people have written in about
s04.notes.f_note_206.block_001: Clasp and a knitted sleeve — nine
s04.notes.f_note_206.block_003: The blue light at night — six
s04.notes.f_note_207.title: The base unit question
s04.notes.f_note_207.body:
A man wrote asking whether it needs a telephone, because his father does not have one and will not have one.

Every competing product assumes a smartphone in the house. That assumption quietly excludes exactly the people the category claims to serve, and nobody has said so because saying so means building a base unit and a base unit is unglamorous.

We built the unglamorous thing. Lead with it.
s04.notes.f_note_208.title: Braga — thirty units
s04.notes.f_note_208.body:
Thirty is more than we have ever sent anywhere. The honest answer is that our stock is 214 enclosures and our support is two people, one of whom is me at midnight.

Go and see the building. If it is two floors like São Bento we can do it. If it is four we will fail in public and the failure will be the story.
s04.notes.f_note_209.title: Not for children
s04.notes.f_note_209.body:
A teacher has asked. Tiago's daughter wore one to school and told the class she has a tracker.

We are not making one for children. Not because it would not sell — it would sell enormously — but because the moment it is on a child it stops being a way of asking for help and becomes a way of knowing where somebody is. Those are opposite products with the same components.

Write this down properly before somebody offers us money.
s04.notes.f_note_210.title: The talk — actual notes
s04.notes.f_note_210.body:
Open with the radio report that came back twice. Everybody has that drawer.

The middle is the eleven months, honestly told, including the two months where nothing happened because I was waiting for an email.

Do not end on the daughter and the eleven minutes. It is true and it will work and using it to end a talk would be the cheapest thing I have ever done.
s04.notes.f_note_211.title: Stock
s04.notes.f_note_211.block_003: Straps — 240, of which 60 are the old clasp
s04.notes.f_note_212.title: Four years
s04.notes.f_note_212.body:
Vasco asked whether I would have started if somebody had told me it would take four years.

Yes. That is the frightening answer and it is also the only one. Nobody does this on a calculation. The calculation says do not.

He is owed more than he has ever asked for and I have never written that down anywhere he could find it.
s04.notes.f_note_213.title: Words we do not use
s04.notes.f_note_213.block_001: Elderly. Say the age or say nothing.
s04.notes.f_note_213.block_002: Monitor. We are not monitoring anybody.
s04.notes.f_note_214.title: If it goes
s04.notes.f_note_214.body:
If the round does not come and the company stops, the 22 bands in São Bento keep working, because they do not need us to be alive. The base units are dumb and the firmware is on them.

That was a decision made in year one against advice and it is the single thing I am most glad about.
